ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What's the difference between Starter (R4,500) and Growth (R12,000)?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Starter gives a small business a clean, credible three-page presence quickly. Growth is a full lead-generation system: up to ten pages, service landing pages, advanced SEO, copywriting guidance, a blog and integrations. If you plan to run ads, SEO or content marketing, Growth is built to feed that engine.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Can I upgrade my package later if my business grows?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Yes. Because we build on assets you own, you can move up a tier or add pages and features whenever you are ready. Many clients start with Business and grow into Growth as their marketing scales.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Do I own the website, the domain, and the accounts after launch?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Always. Your website, domain, hosting, Google Analytics and Search Console accounts are set up in your name from day one. We never hold your assets hostage. If you pay for it, you own it.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What happens if I need changes after the post-launch support window?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: You can take our monthly Hosting & Maintenance plan, which includes an hour of minor edits each month, or request changes as needed. Either way, because you own the site, you are free to use any developer you choose.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Why WordPress and not Wix, Squarespace, or a custom platform?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: WordPress with Elementor gives you full ownership, no locked-in monthly platform fees, and the freedom to host anywhere. It scales from a simple site to e-commerce and is the most SEO-friendly mainstream platform. You are never trapped on a system you cannot leave.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Can you redesign my existing site or do you only build new ones?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: We do both. We will audit your current site, keep what works, and rebuild what is holding you back. In many cases a redesign delivers a big lift without starting completely from scratch.
